//: Pre-seeded MSSQL connection profile for the lab. Kept at WORKSPACE scope (here) rather than in the devcontainer's customizations, because the MSSQL extension reads connection profiles from workspace/user settings — dev-container customizations land in machine-scoped settings, where the profile does not surface (see vscode-mssql#17500). savePassword is FALSE on purpose: with it true the extension looks up the password in the OS credential store (empty in a fresh codespace → 'No saved password found'); false makes it use the inline password directly. These are non-secret lab credentials. Students click-to-connect: open the SQL Server view or a .sql file and pick 'AIDD-MS Lab (AdventureWorksLT)'.
